# Thistledown Market card takings

Gross amounts are in pounds, as settled by the processor. The two market terminals settle through the market's own account and are complete for September.
The borrowed mobile reader was re-registered to the new processor account on 2026-09-22; takings from that day on haven't been exported yet and should arrive once the processor finishes the account migration.

turns.prompt: How much did Thistledown Market take across all its card readers in September?
